bio: I'm a senior in the Duke Kunshan University & Duke University dual-degree program (B.S. Applied Mathematics and Computational Sciences, Mathematics Track). My research centers on making LLM-based agents more reliable over long horizons — how they remember, revise beliefs, and improve from feedback.

I've worked on belief revision for agent memory (Cascade Memory), decoupled instruction refinement for narrative generation (DIR), and self-evolving narrative systems that adapt to players in real time.
